# IMPERLUX-AUDIT-W26 · a rendered audit of imperlux.md, 2026-09-22

**Generated by the harness card W26-02 ships, under ruling W26-R2.** Every reading below
comes from the **rendered DOM** in headless Chrome after the page settles, never from the
HTML response, and every page has a **full-document screenshot** in `docs/audit/imperlux/`.

**Why the rule exists.** W25-24 reported both 4-tile hub sections as gone. It grepped the
HTML response for labels that render client-side, and it screenshotted the first 4,000px of
a page 12,535px long. Both readings were of things that were there. The counts below match
the owner's screenshots exactly, which is the measurement that closes Q-W25-18.

## How a page was read

1. Navigate, then poll `scrollHeight` and the image count until three consecutive readings
   agree. A virtual-time budget that expires before the last request returns is how a
   late-rendered section is missed.
2. Scroll the whole document in 700px steps so every lazy image loads, then return to the top.
3. Read sections in order, every card with its image URL and destination, every table, every
   image and every link.
4. Screenshot the **whole document**, not the viewport.

## What this audit corrects

**W25-24 said both 4-tile hub sections were gone. They are not.** The acoperisuri hub
carries a five-tile bento headed "Produsele noastre. Alege acoperisul potrivit." at 1,876px
on a 12,535px page, and each tile opens a product section whose count matches the owner's
screenshots to the product. The garduri hub carries its own sections below the fold.

**The error was the method, twice over**, and both halves are now forbidden by W26-R2:
reading the HTML response for text that renders client-side, and reading "not present" off
a screenshot of the top of a long page.

## What may not be copied from these pages

Every roofing product card carries a **percent badge** and a **struck price**, and the fence
offers block carries a **countdown** and a stock-limited claim. R-X forbids all of those on
this site and `scripts/check-scarcity.js` gates them; W25-R8 and W26-R5 take the current
"de la" figure only. **Warranty rows are held** until the owner confirms them: Q-W25-19 is
answered for the fences (leave it off) and the roof rows are still open.
